evidenceLimits: No own console captures or revision-specific electrical measurements.
453726 pairs and final71 RAM/register states are externally compared;14527424 counts executed phases, not independently verified electrical RAM slots.
262144 register observations and2048 full ARAM digests are individually compared at clock boundaries; separate literal RAM phase worksheets and mutations cover order/address/value/direction.
Soft reset follows the selected research reference; external reset-pin behaviour and rapid DAC mute pulses remain unverified.
Ten-second NTSC/PAL AV runs are executed; one-hour M2 rational clock checks remain separate analytical evidence.
Laboratory SPC container is deliberately limited, not a universal music player/exact hidden-state restoration.
No general commercial-game compatibility claim; graphics modes2–7 and variable geometry remain M7.
